name: TutorRequests

Kit segmented control with count badge, elevated cards, money leads with the mode pill top-right, term/recurrence removed from feed cards (detail-only), green Matches-you, raised indigo create FAB. Supersedes the pre-kit feed; other participate screens reconcile in a dedicated session. name: Applied request detail
summary: B-final read-only variant: approved banner, name + address unlocked on approval, no apply/comment. The file also carries the unavailable state and the Apply confirm sheet.

name: Request filters
summary: Quiet accordion (hub v0.32): collapsed value-summary rows, one section open at a time; your-subjects + your-levels smart defaults, decoupled plain subject names, pin + radius flag-gated on the backend location model.

name: Class schedule (calendar)
summary: Reconciliation screen 1 (locked 11-Jul): the first pre-kit page re-cut to the validated 23-element system, ten states shipped. Chip week strip (harmonizes with the done-moment anatomy), the new calendar-drawer element (24) for month jumps, time-aware Next-up card (quiet -> Clock in appears in the silent 15-min grace window -> Teaching-now pill into the locked cockpit), sections only on today, cancelled stays hidden (grey-row proposal declined), clock-out cockpit-only. CENTER TAB = HOME GLYPH (founder-ruled here): the pilot plus is retired; create placement now owned by the Today/nav pitch. Decision arcs kept honestly on the board incl. two more draft-pick-is-not-a-lock reversals.

name: AddClassSchedule
summary: Reconciliation screen 2 (locked 11-Jul), fifteen states - the Calendar plus and empty-state destination. Drill-in rows with slot cards under Slots · N, WHO -> WHEN, single scroll + sticky CTA. The When sheet runs the element-24 month grid + a wheel time picker (the honest pair: any minute is valid, no invented slot grid - the time-chips draft was reversed at founder challenge) + duration pills; clash is caught in-sheet with the earned crimson, the form-level clash state retired. Backdate three-tier family (14/180 ladder, per-tier proof sublabels, compulsory reason gate over 14d), paused-request freeze, three success moments at one quality floor (toast onto the reconciled Calendar / the done-moment toast verbatim / one full escalation recap). Mode is display-only from the request, stated in the UI. PARKED CANDIDATE (12-Jul, from the extra-class removal): whether the beyond-plan pending_approval branch deserves states here (banner + pending recap) - open founder call, flagged not silently dropped.

name: EvaluationReport
summary: First-class baseline form: full-bleed photo intro + baseline-score dial (no trend) + vertical-ladder rating. Absorbs two old screens.

name: ProgressReport
summary: Recurring 12-class report: credit-score dial (baseline to now trend), per-dimension movement, and a Luna parent verdict.

name: StudentsDetails
summary: Identity hero + a compact 2x2 contact grid (Call / WhatsApp / Email / Directions). Admin field cut, registration demoted.

name: Teaching now (live-class cockpit)
summary: Teach-loop screen 1, rebuilt 100% from the locked kit (locked 10-Jul, first post-Wave-1 screen). Name-led context card, the registered progress dial at 150px hero, parent-notified banner at the top of flow, quiet Extend that promotes to outline in the over-run state (second file), docked Clock out. Contact-parent cut by founder earns-its-spot re-run. EXTEND RIDER (locked 12-Jul, seven states): extending requires ONE typed reason - PAID (parent asked; CTA renames Ask the parent; parent confirms first, the only async path) / FREE (direct commit; the parent sees the gift, never charged) / MAKE-UP (founder-ruled NO admin verification: direct commit + parent notified; picker pre-filled from clock truth). Extra-class REMOVED with production evidence (the /extra-class route is an alias of /add-class, B8 comment verbatim). Supersedes the scrapped HIG-era cockpit and the parked pre-wave draft.

name: Wrap up (clock-out capture)
summary: Teach-loop screen 2 (locked 11-Jul), kit-composed on the Grab end-of-trip canon: receipt-first header with the ACTUAL duration taught (matches what the backend records - zero backend work), one optional capture sheet (never a stepper), Well pre-selected on the rect segmented so a normal class finishes in one tap, Grab dashed-frame photo row, Finish always enabled. Clock out navigates only; attendance + photo + notes all fire on Finish class. Supersedes the old clock-out frame and the HIG-era 3-options exploration. NEXT-TOUCH (header canon 11-Jul): root-anatomy 30px header goes to arrow + centred compact 18/700.

name: Class recorded (done moment)
summary: Teach-loop screen 3 (locked 11-Jul), founder ruling: NO dedicated done screen (Grab no-dead-end canon) - the moment is a transient rich toast over the Schedule landing with the truth visible: green Attended pill, payment truth (follows once the parent verifies - a real backend mechanic), journey temporal tint on the rows. Toast bottom/floats per the contrast table; backdrop = the EXISTING ClassSchedule anatomy with the pilot tab bar verbatim, no invented surfaces. Note echo relocates to the class card/detail (cross-screen contract). Supersedes the old done frame and the entire 5-board done exploration set (shown-and-marked). CROSS-SCREEN CONTRACT (11-Jul ClassSchedule ruling d): picks up the HOME center tab at next touch. PLUS the ONE-NAME ruling: the landing header retitles Schedule -> Calendar at the same touch.

name: Confirm classes (payment gate)
summary: Teach-loop screen 4 (locked 11-Jul), completes the loop: the report backlog as a pre-checked deselectable ledger (checkboxes TRAIL per the revised placement grammar - ruled at this screen's eyeball), 3-line header (RM 580 pending · 8 classes; Confirm they ran. Payment follows once verified.), on-hold rows amber at compact-12 with the sheet-open review shipped as its own state (third file, founder-caught: one-bare-file-per-state applies to consumed components too), one bold total per the money law. AMENDMENT CLOSED (founder lock, 11-Jul, after his own-browser eyeball on the published pair): confirm-kit--onhold-r2 IS the record - the original --onhold retired from compare, superseded, board kept; the r2 siblings (sheet / resume-pending / released) and the 7-board parent set ride the same lock. Type-law record stands: off-canon 13/15/13.5px normalized to canon 12/14/16 in r2; the 2px row-gap + 18px sheet-pad idioms retained. NEXT-TOUCH (header canon 11-Jul): the root-anatomy 30px header goes to arrow + centred compact 18/700 - applies to the r2 family too. Kit re-skin honoring the prior cycle's terminal layout; supersedes the 8-board confirm exploration set (shown-and-marked). Entry point/nav slot = open, owned by the Today/nav pitch.

name: Class records
summary: Lean history list on one shared class card (name, RM, subject, date, then ID + status), a single-class detail hero, and a grouped filter. No duplicated facts; scan-clean cards.

name: Class edit + parent gate
summary: Class management trio: quick-pick Extend, a from-to Postpone comparison, and a neutral parent-approval gate where declining is as easy as confirming.

name: Success variants
summary: Five confirmation screens brought to one quality floor (varied by design, off-brand drift removed): postpone, schedule added, backdate review with ticket, evaluation, progress.

name: Students + tasks
summary: Students and submitted reports (with sort + filter). The pending-tasks job moved to Confirm classes (teach-loop 4, kit-composed); the empty state stays here until the reconciliation session.

name: Clock in (arrival gate)
summary: Reconciliation screen 3 (locked 11-Jul), ten states - the stitch between the Calendar --now button and the locked Teaching-now cockpit (tap -> shutter -> teaching, two gestures). Draft C: the live map DNA demoted to a compact r16 map card over the identity dock, one filled tap pill, no slider (zero in 241 Grab frames), no CTA subtext (the law fired a third time, self-caught). POLICY A founder-ruled: GPS denied = warn-and-allow with the amber note - the start photo still proves presence; blocked clock-ins corrupt attendance truth (B kept compare-only on the board). Three deliberate non-inventions queued not drawn: too-far needs geocoding (PROPOSAL), offline queued-sync does not exist (honest-current state), online meet-link has no backend field (silent absence). Character pass: gendered stock photos replaced by initials avatars; the raw jtuid cut (demoted, recorded). Camera = the R10 start-photo moment.

name: Camera + demand card
summary: The proof-capture camera reconciled as the clock-in start-photo state (opaque chrome, viewfinder corners, one-photo copy, shutter into the cockpit). The old stock-camera + demand-card mock is superseded; the Home demand-card job rides the Today/nav pitch.

name: ProfileMenu
summary: A clean one-liner navigation hub with a milestone progress card up top.

name: UpdateProfile
summary: Re-skinned as the real name + email screen (verified phone locked, optional referral). Dead date-of-birth field cut.

name: ConsentGate
summary: Terms + a Privacy summary + a consent checkbox + "Agree & continue" where the save happens. Casing bug fixed.

name: Payments (money surface)
summary: Reconciliation screen 4 (locked 12-Jul), six states, draft C records-first (the two-bucket rec declined, recorded). THE RULING THAT BINDS EVERY MONEY SURFACE: no commission mention, ever - tutors are paid their agreed rate; gross/net splits never surface tutor-side (the UC fee-transparency adaptation was caught serving the wrong audience; the what-is-commission sheet deleted). Payout rows lead under a calm In-progress card with the schedule coach-line; cycle buckets = awaiting NEUTRAL GREY (verifying is normal, not amber) / verified green; no withdraw CTA (business truth); class ledger rate-only with scheduled-vs-actual times; slip-share = trailing icon-button in the pushed header (canon extension). Bank-transfer receipt row removed (transfer_proof_url unconsumed tutor-side, recorded). Supersedes the pre-kit hub/ledger/pending trio.

name: Payment ledger (receipt)
summary: ABSORBED into Payments (12-Jul): the payout detail is now payment-kit--payout.html - slip-share via the trailing header icon-button, deductions re-cased non-commission at payout level where TutorPayment addition/deduction live. This pre-kit receipt board is superseded, kept for history.

name: Refer a friend + Referral earnings

name: My tickets

name: Ticket detail
